name: deepchat
tagline_zh: 当别人还在网页里问AI，你已让AI读你的邮件、日历和笔记。DeepChat把大模型接进你的个人数据，对话即操作。
tagline_en: While others chat in a browser, DeepChat lets AI read your mail, calendar, and notes—private, local, and ready to.
desc_en: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world
why_zh: 它不只是一个聊天框，而是把AI嵌入你的数字生活，通过本地数据连接，让每次对话都带着你的上下文。
why_en: Not just a chatbox—it embeds AI into your digital life, linking local data so every reply is context-aware.
